messages:
maya: starting small change window for reranker-service. rolling reranker-v2-quant to 12% now. primary watch: p95, 5xx, and sampling/trace coverage. deploy-bot: rollout started: reranker-service -> reranker-v2-quant (12%). rollout id r-2026-05-01-09 :rocket:
ben: watching SLOs. alert thresholds: p95 > 150ms or 5xx > 0.25%. also verifying tracing sample rate didn't drop for canary slice. :eyes:
kiara: quick heads up 1: we changed the tracing sampler back-end config last week; canary sample rate might be lower by region. double-checking.
oncall: noticed sampling_rate{service="reranker-service",slice="canary"} = 0.6% in eu-west-1, baseline stable slice = 2.5%.
ben: that explains low trace coverage. we rely on traces to triage 5xx root cause. low sampling impedes quick rollback decision.
maya: can we temporarily bump sampling for canary slices? we have short window.
kiara: yes patching tracing config now for the canary: setting TRACE_SAMPLER_OVERRIDE=1.5 (multiplier) for canary pods. running:
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/reranker-canary TRACE_SAMPLER_OVERRIDE=1.5 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/reranker-canary -n prod
```
kiara: applied and rolling.
alert-bot: automated check: canary p95 eu-west-1 = 162ms (baseline 110ms). 5xx rate increased from 0.04% to 0.38% in canary slice over 20m. alert id slo-2217. paging eng-oncall in 2m.
ben: ack. hold further ramp. not going to 35%.
oncall: traces now back to ~1.9% sample rate after restart in eu-west-1. linking trace set: https://traces.internal/ghi101
kiara: looking at traces 1: many 5xx originate from an upstream feature-flagged ranking call failing with HTTP 502 on a small percentage of requests. stack shows short-lived downstream connection resets during cold-starts.
maya: are these correlated with pod restarts? prom query for pod restarts over last 30m: ```query
increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{pod=~"reranker-canary.*"}[30m])
```
ben: results: restarts = 0. cold-starts not likely.
kiara: suspect it's transient connection pool exhaustion on the outbound HTTP client when quantized model inference takes longer for certain token lengths. 5xx stack traces show timeout in http client: connect timeout -> upstream 502.
maya: can we mitigate quickly? maybe lower concurrency or add a short timeout/backoff.
ben: propose hotpatch: set OUTBOUND_CONN_POOL=50 -> 30 for canary deployment and restart. will do if approved.
oncall: agree, safer to reduce pool and observe.
ben: applying hotpatch:
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/reranker-canary OUTBOUND_CONN_POOL=30 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/reranker-canary -n prod
```
alert-bot: deployment restart detected.
ben: after restart p95 trending down to 125ms in eu-west-1 canary, 5xx down to 0.06%. sampling remains ~1.8%.
maya: good recovery. plan: keep canary at 12% for 40m, rerun full perf smoke including trace coverage. if stable, ramp to 50%. if regression returns > 0.25% 5xx or p95 > 150ms we'll pin back to reranker-v1 and document root cause.
kiara: also creating follow-up ticket INF-1107 to add pre-ramp trace-sample verification and an automated pre-ramp connection-pool check.
oncall: noted. deploy-bot: rollout update: reranker-service -> reranker-v2-quant at 12% (stable after connection-pool hotpatch).
ben: reminder command to pin if needed: `deployctl pin --service reranker-service --version reranker-v1 --reason "canary 5xx regression/connection pool"` (immediate failover).
maya: annotating release notes with tracer sampling issue and hotpatch. link: https://docs.internal/releases/reranker/2026-05-01
kiara: adding suggestion to include a short warmup job to exercise common token lengths before ramp. ticket linked INF-1108.
maya: thanks everyone. reconvene in 40m with final ramp decision. :thumbsup:
